title: The Great Commission
definition: The Great Commission is Christ's command to make disciples of all nations by going, baptizing, and teaching obedience to His Word.
summary: The Church's mission is disciple-making under Christ's authority.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His Church with all authority and promises His presence to the end of the age.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Great Commission teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the church's mission is disciple-making under christ's authority.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. The Great Commission calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let the great commission move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
